dedupe_keys.name: tfl bus stop locations and routes

description: TfL Bus Stop Locations and Routes is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Greater London Authority. TfL's operates one of the largest bus networks in the world consisting of over 19,000 bus stops and approximately 700 routes served by some 8000 buses daily. This datafile defines the network in terms of routes and stops and stop-sequences allowing third parties to accurately locate bus stops and to plot bus routes and services. Coverage: Greater London Authority. The portal files it under the publisher Greater London Authority. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
